stem.text: Which statements about a mammalian heart are correct?

items: The right atrium and right ventricle contain deoxygenated blood going to the lungs.
The left atrium and left ventricle contain oxygenated blood going to the pulmonary circulation.
The left ventricle has a thicker wall than the right ventricle and delivers blood at higher pressure.
The pressure of blood in the aorta is less than that in the pulmonary artery.
